parameters.help_en:
The input parameters for the digital human task. Text, audio files stored in OSS, and media assets are supported as input. Audio files support only the MP3 or WAV format.
<notice>The length of the input text cannot be less than 5 characters.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
虚拟人任务输入参数。支持以文本、音频OSS文件、媒资作为输入。音频仅支持mp3或wav格式。
<notice>Text 的输入内容长度不能少于 5 个字。></notice>
parameters.name: input_config

parameters.help_en: The configuration information for the digital human task. You can configure information such as the digital human ID, voice, and speech rate
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟人任务配置信息，支持设置虚拟人id、人声、语速等信息
parameters.name: editing_config

parameters.help_en: The output information of the task. You can configure the output address
parameters.help_zh: 任务输出信息，支持设置输出地址
parameters.name: output_config

parameters.help_en: The title of the task. The title can be up to 128 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 任务标题，长度不超过128字节
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en: The description of the task. The description can be up to 128 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 任务描述，长度不超过128字节
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The custom settings of the user. You can pass in customer business information, such as the business environment and task information, in JSON string format
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义设置，可传入客户业务信息，如业务方环境、任务信息，JSON字符串格式
